ja.title: Telisotuzumab vedotinの初期用量を公開PK・E–Rモデルで考える
ja.seo_title: Telisotuzumab vedotinの初期用量 | Daiki Kumakura
ja.summary: 公表PK・初期曝露のE–R式で固定用量と初期低用量を比較。4096組の条件付き解析から、曝露の時間配分と静的モデルで判断できる範囲を考える。

en.title: Telisotuzumab vedotin initial dosing with public PK and exposure-response models
en.summary: A reproducible PK and exposure–response comparison of fixed and initial lower doses of telisotuzumab vedotin.

english.title: Telisotuzumab vedotin initial dosing with public PK and exposure-response models
english.summary: Conditional simulations compare fixed and lower-start dosing. Public first-cycle association models illustrate preference and coefficient sensitivity without establishing sequential-regimen clinical benefit.
